title: Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker)
description:
Empresa está contratando Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker) em bragança paulista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company DescriptionBrooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.Role DescriptionWe are seeking a detail-oriented and organizedFamily-Based Immigration Paralegalto join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.Key ResponsibilitiesPrepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documentsCollect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracyMaintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-upsCommunicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiriesAssist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidanceDraft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materialsMonitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulationsHandle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalismQualificationsPrior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based casesStrong working knowledge of USCIS forms and proceduresExcellent organizational and time-management skillsStrong written and verbal communication abilitiesAbility to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environmentBilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only﻿To ApplyTo be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market DevelopmentIdentify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.RequirementsExperience5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGPLATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARSExperience working at:Global banksEM FX trading firmsPayment / fintech companiesCrypto exchanges or market makersProven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical ExpertiseDeep understanding of:FX market microstructure in illiquid marketsNDF markets and offshore hedgingCapital controls and FX regulatory frameworksHands-on experience building or optimizing:FX trading systemsHedging enginesLiquidity aggregation platformsFamiliarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.SkillsStrong quantitative and analytical capabilities.Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred QualificationsExperience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.Strong analytical and problem solving skillsAbility to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & MissionOSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Empresa está contratando Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker) em salto. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company DescriptionBrooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.Role DescriptionWe are seeking a detail-oriented and organizedFamily-Based Immigration Paralegalto join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.Key ResponsibilitiesPrepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documentsCollect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracyMaintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-upsCommunicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiriesAssist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidanceDraft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materialsMonitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulationsHandle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalismQualificationsPrior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based casesStrong working knowledge of USCIS forms and proceduresExcellent organizational and time-management skillsStrong written and verbal communication abilitiesAbility to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environmentBilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only﻿To ApplyTo be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
Empresa está contratando Strategic partnership & alliance em sapucaia do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. aggregation platformsFamiliarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.SkillsStrong quantitative and analytical capabilities.Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred QualificationsExperience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.Strong analytical and problem solving skillsAbility to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & MissionOSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
Confira a vaga para Strategic partnership & alliance em mogi das cruzes. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. description:

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: English teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando English teacher em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Implementation analyst
description:

Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:BrazilType:Full-Time ContractSetup:Fully RemoteLevel:Mid-LevelIndustry:Software SAAS CompanyShift:US HoursStart Date:can start in 2 weeks after offerEquipment:Available upon requestRate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical GroupThe Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the OpportunityOur client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. parceiros e clientes;Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades RequeridasProficiência em mandarimGraduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.AtributosProatividade;Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Trabalho em equipe;Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);Senso de urgência;Multitarefa;Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.
